# Knowledge base

| feature | summary | spec | contract |
|---|---|---|---|

| rail | Rail cards, attention versus manual order, pin, drag reorder, session count. | `docs/features/rail/spec.md` | `docs/features/rail/contract.md` |
| release | GoReleaser, the curl-pipe-sh installer, minisign signing, the Homebrew tap, the commit-msg guard. | `docs/features/release/spec.md` | `docs/features/release/contract.md` |
| rename | Muster-owned session title override, inline rename in the mainhead and tiles. | `docs/features/rename/spec.md` | `docs/features/rename/contract.md` |
| settings | Settings dialog and the prefs it edits. | `docs/features/settings/spec.md` | `docs/features/settings/contract.md` |
| shortcuts | Keyboard chords routed to views, focus and tiles. | `docs/features/shortcuts/spec.md` | `docs/features/shortcuts/contract.md` |
| surfaces | PTY bridge, xterm pane, the ephemeral shell surface, sizing, one live client per target. | `docs/features/surfaces/spec.md` | `docs/features/surfaces/contract.md` |
| theme | Muster theme preference and the Claude theme family poll. | `docs/features/theme/spec.md` | `docs/features/theme/contract.md` |
| tiles | Tiles view: slot-stable grid, strip, tile drag, density, snapshot-not-live rule. | `docs/features/tiles/spec.md` | `docs/features/tiles/contract.md` |
| triage | GitHub issues into TODO.md through a program, and the pre-commit link guard. | `docs/features/triage/spec.md` | `docs/features/triage/contract.md` |
| update | Release check, minisign-verified apply, in-place restart with sessions re-adopted. | `docs/features/update/spec.md` | `docs/features/update/contract.md` |
| usage | Masthead usage bars, per-model weekly bar, per-session context gauge, usage poll and Keychain read. | `docs/features/usage/spec.md` | `docs/features/usage/contract.md` |
| views | Focus and Tiles switch, density preference, view containers. | `docs/features/views/spec.md` | `docs/features/views/contract.md` |

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only` — The daemon captures each live pane on every liveness tick and serves the last capture for a dead session, dimmed under an ended cap; display only. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus) → `docs/adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session` — Remove is allowed on a live session; it ends the session first and its dialog says so, then deletes the row and broadcasts sessionRemoved. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-claude-auto-updater-left-on` — Muster never freezes Claude Code's auto-updater; it detects and classifies the installed version at startup and lets the canary gate what is verified. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-claude-auto-updater-left-on.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-drives-installed-claude-through-production-chain` — The canary launches the installed claude through the production settings, shell, wrapper and enveloped POST chain; previously skipped field tests are binding. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-drives-installed-claude-through-production-chain.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-live-tier-fails-never-skips` — The canary's live tier runs the production Keychain, usage and theme readers on the real machine and fails, never skips, when a credential is missing. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-live-tier-fails-never-skips.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-permission-mode-sweep-on-unauthenticated-path` — Every permission-mode value is swept on the zero-token unauthenticated run and cross-checked once on the authenticated run, not a turn per mode. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-permission-mode-sweep-on-unauthenticated-path.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-plan-mode-step-three-sole-residual` — Permission requests, notifications and the first two plan-mode steps are asserted with the dialog unanswered; only the post-approval step stays a probe. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-plan-mode-step-three-sole-residual.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-refresh-interval-key-canary-only` — The canary writes statusLine.refreshInterval, a settings key production never writes, so the idle-tick fact has a guard. (accepted, 2026-09-12; features: canary, usage, ingest) → `docs/adr/canary-refresh-interval-key-canary-only.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-resume-run-through-production-argv` — The canary resumes a real session through the production resume argv and asserts the same session id, retiring the manual end-then-resume check. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-resume-run-through-production-argv.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-run-d-holds-two-claude-sessions` — Run D types /clear in its idle window, so one MUSTER_SESSION spans two claude session ids and every status-line view names which one it means. (accepted, 2026-09-12; features: canary, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/canary-run-d-holds-two-claude-sessions.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-skips-on-ceiling-bump-extends-record` — The canary skips its token-burning tiers when installed equals the ceiling unless forced; a green run outside the range appends the version, uncommitted. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-skips-on-ceiling-bump-extends-record.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-static-tier-asserts-bundle-strings` — A static canary tier reads the installed Claude Code bundle for the interface strings Muster depends on but cannot drive; it catches rename or removal only. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-static-tier-asserts-bundle-strings.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-subagentstop-not-a-surface` — The subagent stop hook is inert to Muster and its inventory row is dropped from the canary; the only subagent dependency is the agent marker on tool hooks. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary, ingest) → `docs/adr/canary-subagentstop-not-a-surface.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-verified-range-observed-not-pinned` — The Claude Code posture is an observed verified range held in one embedded record of green canary versions; the exact pin and its equality check are gone. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-verified-range-observed-not-pinned.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-banner-only-after-first-hello` — The daemon-down banner appears only after a first successful hello; a fresh page load shows a connecting state instead. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-banner-only-after-first-hello.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-built-assets-ignored-with-gitkeep` — Built dashboard assets are gitignored; a committed placeholder keeps the embed directive compiling on a fresh clone, and the web build restores it. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-built-assets-ignored-with-gitkeep.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-commands-http-ws-push-only` — Commands go over HTTP; the state WebSocket is server-to-client only, and the only client-to-server socket traffic is terminal input and resize. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-commands-http-ws-push-only.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-dashboard-auto-opens-on-terminal` — musterd opens the dashboard in the browser at startup by default, only when stdin is a real terminal; that condition, not the flag, keeps tests browser-free. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-dashboard-auto-opens-on-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-dashboard-embedded-in-binary` — The built dashboard is embedded in musterd and served by default; the disk directory flag remains as a development override with unchanged behaviour. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-dashboard-embedded-in-binary.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-installed-claude-classified-never-refused` — The installed Claude Code is classified unknown, below, verified or above; the daemon serves identically in all four and the masthead shows a glyph, no dismiss. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: connection, canary) → `docs/adr/connection-installed-claude-classified-never-refused.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-missing-web-build-fails-fast` — A musterd built with no dashboard and no disk override exits non-zero at startup naming both remedies, replacing the old silent-404 mode. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-missing-web-build-fails-fast.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-protocol-bumps-only-on-shape-change` — The protocol version bumps only when an existing field changes shape; additive messages and fields do not bump, and a skewed open tab is told to reload. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-protocol-bumps-only-on-shape-change.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-ui-token-reusable-not-one-time` — The UI token is reusable at the auth endpoint for the install's life; one-time described the launcher flow, not token burning. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-ui-token-reusable-not-one-time.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-whole-object-session-upserts` — The state stream sends whole session objects on every change; the client replaces by id and sorts for display itself. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: connection, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/connection-whole-object-session-upserts.md`
- `kb:adr/drop-daemon-locates-original-never-stages` — Dropping a file on a live pane types the original file's escaped path: the daemon locates it on disk by name, size and bytes, or types nothing; never a copy. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, surfaces) → `docs/adr/drop-daemon-locates-original-never-stages.md`
- `kb:adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type` — Internal tile and rail reorder drags carry a Muster-specific MIME type instead of text/plain, so a dragover can tell a reorder from dragged text. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal` — A pointer click on a rail card puts keyboard focus in that session's terminal; keyboard activation, number chords and the Tiles strip only select. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: focus, rail, surfaces) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane` — The Focus view is a rail of static cards beside exactly one live pane, with account usage in a persistent masthead. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: focus, rail, usage) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers` — Every hook and the status line is a command wrapper that exits silently when unmanaged or when the daemon is down; Muster writes no http hook entries. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding` — Every event is enveloped; a new session_id on an enveloped event is a clear-style rebind, a never-bound session binds on it, raw and status posts never bind. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent` — Muster's hook entries in a directory are permanent by design; no reference counting, no strip on shutdown, no strip on remove. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind` — An enveloped event never rebinds a session backwards onto a Claude session_id it has already left; reordered stragglers apply without rebinding. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-separate-token-in-url-path` — Two tokens: the UI token is exchanged for a strict same-site cookie, and a separate ingest token is embedded in the hook URL path. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: ingest, connection) → `docs/adr/ingest-separate-token-in-url-path.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest` — Events carry no timestamps or order, so the daemon assigns a monotonic seq at ingest, returns 200 at once, and processes asynchronously. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary` — MergeSettings single-quotes both command-hook paths at the write boundary; the default data dir with a space stays and nothing else quotes. (accepted, 2026-08-25; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-wire-shaped-fixtures-via-claudecodetest` — Tests outside the Claude Code package get wire-shaped bodies from a claudecodetest helper package rather than narrowing the boundary check. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/ingest-wire-shaped-fixtures-via-claudecodetest.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-auth-gh-token-at-time-of-use` — Issue filing uses the GitHub CLI's token read at time of use; nothing is stored, there is no OAuth flow, and the GitHub host is a single flag default. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-auth-gh-token-at-time-of-use.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-capture-then-file-server-held` — Filing is two steps: the daemon holds an immutable snapshot in a small expiring store, and the file request names the held capture, never a client payload. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-capture-then-file-server-held.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-daemon-creates-issues-only` — The daemon's involvement ends at creating an issue: no reading, labels or status sync; a filed issue's fate is a developer-workflow concern outside musterd. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue, triage) → `docs/adr/issue-daemon-creates-issues-only.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred` — The issue dialog ships its disabled primary button with no distinct visual state, like every other button; an app-wide disabled sweep is a backlog item. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue, theme) → `docs/adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-payload-allowlist-never-dump` — The issue snapshot is assembled by explicit field copy from a pinned allowlist; prompt-derived, identifying and account-usage data are excluded forever. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-payload-allowlist-never-dump.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-preview-is-the-leak-check` — The issue dialog renders the daemon's snapshot markdown verbatim before posting, and E2E asserts the preview is byte-identical to the body GitHub receives. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-preview-is-the-leak-check.md`
- `kb:adr/knowledge-protocol-sections-addressed-by-anchor-ids` — Protocol sections are addressed by stable anchor ids in HTML comments, not section numbers; every citation is an anchor token the kb check validates. (accepted, 2026-09-11; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/knowledge-protocol-sections-addressed-by-anchor-ids.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-browse-via-daemon-not-native-chooser` — Directory choice browses through a daemon listing endpoint rooted at a configurable home, because browsers never reveal a picked folder's absolute path. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-browse-via-daemon-not-native-chooser.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode` — The launch form asks for model and starting permission mode; the mode seeds a last-known latch that the first hook corrects. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-hybrid-mru-directory-memory` — Directory memory is hybrid MRU plus promotion; v1 recognises a worktree it is pointed at but never creates one. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-hybrid-mru-directory-memory.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-model-presets-passed-verbatim` — The Model control offers named presets, including fable, that are passed to --model verbatim; the daemon accepts any non-empty model string. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-model-presets-passed-verbatim.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-permission-modes-offered-four-tabbed` — The Start-in control offers Claude Code's four tabbed modes under its own labels; default stays the wire value behind manual and auto is new end to end. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-permission-modes-offered-four-tabbed.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-picker-recent-sidebar-plus-browse-list` — The launch dialog is a Finder-style picker: a Recent sidebar beside a breadcrumb over one child listing, where the listed directory is the selection. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-picker-recent-sidebar-plus-browse-list.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir` — Muster instruments a directory through project-scoped .claude settings, never through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, which breaks subscription OAuth. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json` — Muster writes the gitignored project settings.local.json, which alone honours hooks and status line, so the ingest token never lands in a committable file. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-trust-prompt-never-auto-answered` — The workspace-trust prompt is surfaced to the user and never auto-answered; it is detected by absence of signal plus Muster's records. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-trust-prompt-never-auto-answered.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-alive-flag-not-a-state` — Liveness is an orthogonal alive flag, not a seventh state; a resumed session re-enters idle and a clear resets gauges but not identity. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-alive-flag-not-a-state.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-ended-rows-swept-next-start` — On start, rows already ended are deleted and live rows whose pane is gone are marked ended and kept, so every death gets one resume chance. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-ended-rows-swept-next-start.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-liveness-from-pane-existence` — Whether a session is alive is decided by tmux pane existence alone; SessionEnd is a hint and never sets or clears alive. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-liveness-from-pane-existence.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-migrations-add-tables-when-written` — A migration ships only the tables its milestone writes; the spec's schema sketch is not frozen into the first migration. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-migrations-add-tables-when-written.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-prompt-ordering-guards` — Events apply in seq order; Stop-family events close their prompt_id, a closed prompt never reopens, and an unseen prompt_id starts a turn. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-prompt-ordering-guards.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-reconcile-before-first-snapshot` — Reconcile on start runs synchronously before the first snapshot is served; unknown Muster-shaped tmux sessions are logged and never adopted. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-reconcile-before-first-snapshot.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session` — Resuming a dead session keeps the Muster row and its title and rebinds it to the new pane, matched on the unchanged Claude session_id. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target` — A Muster session is identified by its tmux target; the Claude session_id is a mutable attribute that /clear replaces in the same pane. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target.md`

- `kb:adr/theme-three-builtin-themes-instrument-default` — Three built-in themes ship: Instrument, the contrast-fixed default, a conventional dark and a standard light, a palette on the accepted direction. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-three-builtin-themes-instrument-default.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-two-layer-tokens-not-white-label` — Theming is two token layers, semantic tokens over per-theme palette blocks, on one single-user dashboard; a custom theme is a source block, not a file. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-two-layer-tokens-not-white-label.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-type-scale-tokens-15px-root` — A seven-step rem type ramp on a 15px root replaces hardcoded sizes; the terminal is outside the ramp and a user text-size control is deferred. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-type-scale-tokens-15px-root.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-drag-reorder-header-handle-insert-shift` — Tiles reorder by dragging the tile header only; a drop on another tile inserts and shifts, never swaps, with neutral feedback and no daemon involvement. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-drag-reorder-header-handle-insert-shift.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid` — A session launched from Tiles is promoted into the live grid, demoting the lowest-priority tile when full, rather than admitted only if a slot is free. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: tiles, launch) → `docs/adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-new-session-button-in-toolbar` — Tiles gets its own New session button in the density toolbar, opening the shared launch dialog; a plus pseudo-tile in the grid was rejected. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: tiles, launch) → `docs/adr/tiles-new-session-button-in-toolbar.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window` — Tile order is per-window and ephemeral, held with grid membership in client state; nothing is persisted and the protocol is untouched. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-slot-stable-grid-never-self-sorts` — The Tiles grid never re-sorts itself by attention: a promoted session takes the demoted tile's slot, survivors keep their order, only the user reorders. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-slot-stable-grid-never-self-sorts.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership` — Tiles grid membership is computed at view entry and density change only; afterwards only user action changes it, so a terminal never vanishes mid-keystroke. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership.md`
- `kb:adr/triage-issue-closes-when-fix-lands` — An issue closes when the fix lands on main via a closes reference in the squash subject, never at triage; duplicates and invalid issues close with approval. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: triage, release) → `docs/adr/triage-issue-closes-when-fix-lands.md`
- `kb:adr/triage-program-not-model-between-github-and-todo` — Nothing between GitHub and the backlog diff is a model with tools: a program fetches, sanitises, routes, splices and commits; a Read-only subagent summarises. (accepted, 2026-09-11; features: triage) → `docs/adr/triage-program-not-model-between-github-and-todo.md`
- `kb:adr/triage-snapshot-untrusted-drop-and-count` — The issue's snapshot JSON is untrusted like the body; a union schema of every shape ever emitted drops and counts unknown fields; the table says reported. (accepted, 2026-09-11; features: triage, issue) → `docs/adr/triage-snapshot-untrusted-drop-and-count.md`
- `kb:adr/triage-state-derived-from-todo` — Triage state is derived, not stored: an issue is triaged iff its number appears in the backlog file; no labels, no close state, no second list to keep in sync. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: triage) → `docs/adr/triage-state-derived-from-todo.md`
- `kb:adr/update-check-pref-governs-checking-only` — One boolean pref, default on, governs only whether the daemon checks for a newer release; applying is always explicit via a button or the update flag. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update, settings) → `docs/adr/update-check-pref-governs-checking-only.md`
- `kb:adr/update-check-runs-in-daemon-daily` — The update check runs in the daemon after listen and then daily via the redirect; an empty base URL disables checking and apply, as every test daemon sets. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-check-runs-in-daemon-daily.md`
- `kb:adr/update-install-kinds-decide-who-may-apply` — The binary classifies its install at startup as dev, homebrew, unmanaged or installer; only installer may apply, the others badge with a remedy or stay silent. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-install-kinds-decide-who-may-apply.md`
- `kb:adr/update-release-knowledge-in-selfupdate-package` — All GitHub-release knowledge lives in one package; the server owns the poller and wire, the command owns the flag, install classification and re-exec. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-release-knowledge-in-selfupdate-package.md`
- `kb:adr/update-restart-is-in-place-reexec-not-shutdown` — Restart after an update stops listeners and store gracefully, never consults the on-exit policy or kills a session, then execs the new binary in place. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-restart-is-in-place-reexec-not-shutdown.md`
- `kb:adr/update-trust-root-minisign-signed-checksums` — A release applies only if its checksums file carries a valid minisign signature against a compiled-in key and the archive's SHA-256 matches; no unsigned. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update, release) → `docs/adr/update-trust-root-minisign-signed-checksums.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-context-gauge-shows-tokens-and-compactions` — The context gauge shows the percentage together with absolute input tokens and a compaction counter, because the percentage alone misleads. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-context-gauge-shows-tokens-and-compactions.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-history-persisted-not-rendered` — Usage samples are persisted as history in v1 but no history UI is built; any timeline joins the post-v1 attention-ribbon family. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-history-persisted-not-rendered.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-keychain-token-read-only` — The daemon reads Claude Code's OAuth token from the macOS Keychain read-only for usage polling; never logged, stored or sent on the wire; tests use file seams. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-keychain-token-read-only.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-model-from-freshest-sample` — The masthead shows the model from the freshest usage sample; flicker under mixed-model sessions is accepted. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-model-from-freshest-sample.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window` — The wire carries every model-scoped weekly window; the masthead shows one, chosen by a selector and persisted as a preference with a default model. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage, settings) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-model-window-polled-from-oauth-api` — The per-model weekly window comes from the daemon polling Claude Code's OAuth usage endpoint on a timer plus a coalesced manual refresh, not the status line. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-model-window-polled-from-oauth-api.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-no-hydration-across-restart` — Account usage reads unknown after a daemon restart until the next status post; per-session context persists on the session row. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-no-hydration-across-restart.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-no-source-interface` — Usage sources share a neutral Sample type and one aggregator, with no Go interface type until a second source forces one. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-no-source-interface.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-sample-dedup-by-value` — A usage sample is recorded and broadcast only when its bucket values or model changed; duplicates are dropped by value, not by timestamp. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-sample-dedup-by-value.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-unknown-renders-word-not-track` — An unknown gauge renders the word unknown with no track drawn; a zero-filled track is forbidden because it reads as zero percent used. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-unknown-renders-word-not-track.md`
- `kb:adr/views-active-segment-click-commits-rename` — Clicking the already-pressed view segment commits an open rename instead of cancelling it and sends no prefs request; switching views still cancels. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: views, rename) → `docs/adr/views-active-segment-click-commits-rename.md`
- `kb:adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers` — The dashboard has two peer views, Focus and Tiles, switched from the masthead or a chord, with the choice persisted daemon-side. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: views, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers.md`
- `kb:adr/worktree-merge-queue-daemon-driven` — Worktree conflict handling is muster-core; the merge queue is a daemon state machine doing git plumbing, with an opt-in integration session for judgment only. (accepted, 2026-09-01) → `docs/adr/worktree-merge-queue-daemon-driven.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/background-completion-new-prompt-id` — A finished background task re-invokes the main agent as a UserPromptSubmit with a new prompt_id whose prompt begins <task-notification>. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-completion-new-prompt-id.md`
- `kb:fact/background-tasks-field` — Stop.background_tasks lists running subagents and backgrounded shells with status "running", [] when nothing is outstanding. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-tasks-field.md`
- `kb:fact/clear-mints-new-session-id` — /clear emits SessionEnd{reason:"clear"} for the old session_id, then SessionStart{source:"clear"} with a new id in the same pane. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.269; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/clear-mints-new-session-id.md`
- `kb:fact/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env` — Command hooks and the status-line script inherit the pane environment on every event, ~50 ms per event; an unmanaged session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.269; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env.md`
- `kb:fact/config-dir-breaks-oauth` — CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolates settings, hooks and transcripts but breaks subscription OAuth ("Not logged in · Please run /login"). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: canary, launch) → `docs/facts/config-dir-breaks-oauth.md`
- `kb:fact/context-window-shape` — context_window carries context_window_size, used/remaining_percentage on a 0-100 scale, token totals and a current_usage object. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: usage) → `docs/facts/context-window-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/fable-model-alias` — fable is a valid --model alias: the bundle's alias switch has case"fable":case"mythos" beside haiku/sonnet/opus. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/fable-model-alias.md`
- `kb:fact/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence` — Headless claude -p fires the full hook sequence, including the command-wrapped SessionStart, so hook probes need no tmux. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: canary, ingest) → `docs/facts/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-commands-are-shell-lines` — Command-hook command and statusLine.command are /bin/sh -c command lines, not argv paths; an unquoted space-bearing path breaks both. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.245..2.1.269; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/facts/hook-commands-are-shell-lines.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-delivery-best-effort` — Hooks are at-most-once with no timestamps or sequence numbers; kill -9 emits nothing and a SIGTERM emits SessionEnd but no Stop-family event. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/hook-delivery-best-effort.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-payload-fields` — Per-event hook field inventory: the common set on every hook, prompt_id on all but SessionStart, and each event's own fields. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/hook-payload-fields.md`
- `kb:fact/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit` — On the authentication-failure exit Claude Code does not wait for hook children: StopFailure is at risk and SessionEnd is usually lost. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.246..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, canary) → `docs/facts/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/local-settings-honoured` — Project-scoped .claude/settings.json and settings.local.json alone each honour hooks, statusLine and allowedHttpHookUrls. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.269; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/facts/local-settings-honoured.md`
- `kb:fact/name-flag-reaches-title` — claude --name X yields SessionStart.session_title == X and status-line session_name == X; the title survives --resume. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.269; features: launch, rename) → `docs/facts/name-flag-reaches-title.md`
- `kb:fact/notification-types-observed` — Notification.notification_type: idle_prompt ~60 s after Stop, and permission_prompt sharing PermissionRequest's prompt_id. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/notification-types-observed.md`
- `kb:fact/oauth-token-in-keychain` — The subscription OAuth token lives in the macOS Keychain item "Claude Code-credentials" as claudeAiOauth.accessToken. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.269; features: usage) → `docs/facts/oauth-token-in-keychain.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-auto-model-gated` — --permission-mode auto is model-gated: on haiku the TUI prints "auto mode unavailable for this model" and every hook reports default. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-auto-model-gated.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-flag-on-wire` — --permission-mode is reflected verbatim on UserPromptSubmit.permission_mode; the CLI's manual choice is spelled default on the wire. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.269; features: launch) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-flag-on-wire.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-presence-split` — permission_mode is not universal: six hook events always carry it, five never do; values seen are default, plan, acceptEdits, auto. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-presence-split.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-request-races-terminal-prompt` — A PermissionRequest hook races the in-terminal prompt; whoever answers first wins, and a timeout, error or empty reply falls back to the stock prompt. (active, 2026-09-12; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-request-races-terminal-prompt.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-suggestions-optional` — PermissionRequest.permission_suggestions is optional: present on a Write request in default mode, absent on ExitPlanMode in plan mode. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/permission-suggestions-optional.md`
- `kb:fact/plan-mode-hook-sequence` — Leaving plan mode fires PreToolUse{ExitPlanMode, plan}, then PermissionRequest{ExitPlanMode}, then PostToolUse{ExitPlanMode, acceptEdits}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/plan-mode-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/rate-limits-wire-shape` — rate_limits has five_hour and seven_day buckets (not weekly), each {used_percentage: float, resets_at: Unix epoch integer}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: usage) → `docs/facts/rate-limits-wire-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/refresh-interval-seconds` — statusLine.refreshInterval is in seconds, not milliseconds, and ticks while idle; without it an idle session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/refresh-interval-seconds.md`
- `kb:fact/resume-keeps-session-identity` — claude --resume <id> emits SessionStart{source:"resume"} with the original session_id and transcript_path. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/facts/resume-keeps-session-identity.md`
- `kb:fact/scroll-speed-env-present` — CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED is present in the installed bundle; the static canary tier asserts every LaunchEnv key by byte string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.269; features: launch, surfaces) → `docs/facts/scroll-speed-env-present.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionend-reason-ambiguous` — SessionEnd.reason is "other" for both a killed pane and a normal exit; only "clear" is distinguishable, and kill -9 emits nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionend-reason-ambiguous.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionstart-model-optional-string` — SessionStart.model, when present, is a plain model-ID string, never an object; it is absent on headless startups and on /clear. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.269; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionstart-model-optional-string.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionstart-not-over-http` — SessionStart is silently never delivered over a type:"http" hook; the other nine events are. A type:"command" hook delivers it. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/sessionstart-not-over-http.md`
- `kb:fact/shift-tab-mode-cycle-fires-no-hook` — Cycling the permission mode with Shift+Tab fires no hook and adds no status-line field, so Muster cannot observe a manual mode change. (active, 2026-09-12; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/shift-tab-mode-cycle-fires-no-hook.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-has-no-model-bucket` — The status line carries only five_hour and seven_day (plus spend_limit on gateway accounts); the per-model weekly window is never copied in. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-has-no-model-bucket.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-keys` — Status-line top-level keys; permission_mode is never among them. Newer versions add scratchpad_dir and prompt_cache (superset). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/status-line-keys.md`
- `kb:fact/status-model-is-object` — The status line's model is an {id, display_name} object; only SessionStart.model is a bare string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/status-model-is-object.md`
- `kb:fact/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs` — Status-line posts are event-driven, ~50 ms after tool activity, and arrive in close pairs a median 435 ms apart. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs.md`
- `kb:fact/status-session-name-source` — Status-line session_name carries --name when given, otherwise a title Claude Code auto-generates; it is absent until one exists. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: rename, usage) → `docs/facts/status-session-name-source.md`
- `kb:fact/status-version-matches-installed` — The status-line version field equals the installed claude --version. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: canary, connection) → `docs/facts/status-version-matches-installed.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-error-taxonomy` — StopFailure.error observed: authentication_failed, server_error, unknown; ten values exist in the binary, and the mapping is not pass-through. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-error-taxonomy.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-replaces-stop` — A failed turn emits StopFailure instead of Stop, never both; a successful turn emits Stop only. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-replaces-stop.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id` — Tool hooks fired by a subagent carry the parent prompt_id plus agent_id and agent_type, and arrive after the parent's Stop when backgrounded. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-permission-request-marked` — A subagent's PermissionRequest carries agent_id and agent_type; the permission_prompt Notification that follows carries no agent marker. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/subagent-permission-request-marked.md`
- `kb:fact/theme-config-key-and-enum` — Claude Code's theme is the global-config key theme with a six-value enum; family is startsWith("light"); default dark. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.258..2.1.269; features: theme) → `docs/facts/theme-config-key-and-enum.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-exit` — The workspace-trust prompt preselects "No, exit" (2.1.259+): a bare Enter exits the session; the harness moves the marker first. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/unknown-before-first-response` — Before a session's first API response rate_limits is absent and the context percentages are null: unknown, not 0%. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.269; features: usage) → `docs/facts/unknown-before-first-response.md`
- `kb:fact/usage-api-oauth-shape` — GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the OAuth bearer and anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20 returns five_hour, seven_day and limits[]. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.269; features: usage) → `docs/facts/usage-api-oauth-shape.md`

## Lessons

- `kb:lesson/authored-tests-never-run-before-validate` — Seven of eleven pins were never run and one hid a locator defect; eight of ten rename specs failed at validate on a bug nobody ran them against. (active, 2026-09-03) → `docs/lessons/authored-tests-never-run-before-validate.md`
- `kb:lesson/banned-string-split-to-dodge-gate` — A negative grep banned a wire string in-scope tests legitimately needed; an agent split the literal, "hook_event" + "_name", flagged Major. (active, 2026-08-22) → `docs/lessons/banned-string-split-to-dodge-gate.md`
- `kb:lesson/completion-claimed-before-approved-verdict` — 'Only approved completes it' was prose only; the state script accepted completed regardless, cycle counts were wrong in 2 of 5 runs. The script refuses now. (active, 2026-09-06) → `docs/lessons/completion-claimed-before-approved-verdict.md`
- `kb:lesson/concurrent-build-invalidates-running-e2e` — A build beside make e2e rewrites the served bundle mid-sweep; 2 'element not found' reds vanished on a clean re-run. Re-run clean before believing a red. (active, 2026-09-07) → `docs/lessons/concurrent-build-invalidates-running-e2e.md`
- `kb:lesson/conditional-test-routing-resolves-to-nobody` — 'A unit test if unit-testable, otherwise E4 covers it' routed a Should-Have to nobody; it shipped with zero coverage and 'not mine' cost a review cycle. (active, 2026-09-03) → `docs/lessons/conditional-test-routing-resolves-to-nobody.md`
- `kb:lesson/decision-made-inside-a-fix-wave` — Two decision items tagged to an impl agent rode three cycles and one produced the next Critical; a post-approval decision changed code, cycle 2 improvised. (active, 2026-08-30) → `docs/lessons/decision-made-inside-a-fix-wave.md`
- `kb:lesson/detach-on-destroy-misrouted-keystrokes` — A spike value measured under one tmux topology was carried into the plan that replaced it; killing one session sent keys to another's claude. (active, 2026-08-23; features: surfaces) → `docs/lessons/detach-on-destroy-misrouted-keystrokes.md`
- `kb:lesson/display-rule-overrides-hidden-attribute` — An author display rule overrides the UA [hidden] default regardless of specificity; six elements had the companion rule, the seventh was the validate failure. (active, 2026-08-22) → `docs/lessons/display-rule-overrides-hidden-attribute.md`
- `kb:lesson/dom-behaviour-gap-between-test-agents` — Fix waves added user-visible behaviour, unit agents rightly left DOM to Playwright, nobody was tagged; seven behaviours shipped untested. (active, 2026-08-22) → `docs/lessons/dom-behaviour-gap-between-test-agents.md`
- `kb:lesson/effect-claimed-from-the-diff` — A 'closed' world-readable window left the WAL sidecar readable; 'references updated' missed a Go comment. Effects are measured and pasted, absences grepped. (active, 2026-09-10) → `docs/lessons/effect-claimed-from-the-diff.md`

- `kb:lesson/handoff-commit-defects` — review.md left untracked; fix-wave commits shipped with the literal '(review cycle N)' or a guessed number. Agents commit their files and copy the label. (active, 2026-08-31) → `docs/lessons/handoff-commit-defects.md`

- `kb:lesson/network-mode-covered-by-http-errors-only` — A requirement named network among failure modes; specs covered only routed HTTP errors, and an unguarded fetch surfaced as a Critical two cycles later. (active, 2026-08-31; features: launch) → `docs/lessons/network-mode-covered-by-http-errors-only.md`
- `kb:lesson/orchestrator-work-spawned-as-agent` — Both harness-only runs spawned a validate agent with nothing to validate, one costing 244 minutes; a doc-only issue fixed beside a wave saved a wave. (active, 2026-09-07) → `docs/lessons/orchestrator-work-spawned-as-agent.md`
- `kb:lesson/per-test-daemons-flaked-the-suite` — One added spec file made make e2e fail 3 of 6 runs with the implementation innocent: every spec spawned its own daemon. Fixtures are explicit and linted. (active, 2026-09-03) → `docs/lessons/per-test-daemons-flaked-the-suite.md`
- `kb:lesson/permission-prompt-needs-unallowlisted-tool` — The user's allowlist applies to spike sessions: Bash(echo hello) was auto-approved and no PermissionRequest fired. - `kb:lesson/pid-file-captures-subshell` — A PID file from $! after a backgrounded cd && nohup chain holds the subshell's PID; a later kill misses or hits a recycled PID. Use pgrep -f. (active, 2026-08-16) → `docs/lessons/pid-file-captures-subshell.md`
- `kb:lesson/plan-asserted-surface-nobody-defined` — An E criterion asserted a card readout no plan section defined; a composed text pattern carried a middot the mockup never had. - `kb:lesson/plan-gave-no-single-owner` — SPEC.md under the Daemon track got edited by daemon-impl; a REQ with no owner was nobody's; a config change sat in an E2E subsection. One owner per file. (active, 2026-08-29) → `docs/lessons/plan-gave-no-single-owner.md`
- `kb:lesson/probe-tmux-sockets-left-in-shared-dir` — A quick probe started tmux with -L names and left sockets in the shared /private/tmp/tmux-*/ dir; probes use -S in a scratch dir and kill-server. (active, 2026-08-23) → `docs/lessons/probe-tmux-sockets-left-in-shared-dir.md`

- `kb:lesson/resize-pane-silent-noop` — tmux resize-pane exits 0 and does nothing on a single-pane window; sizing needs pty.Setsize and resize-window together, measured zero-diff at five widths. (active, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces) → `docs/lessons/resize-pane-silent-noop.md`
- `kb:lesson/rg-shim-invisible-to-bare-subshell` — An authored check ran rg via bash -c and failed: rg is Claude Code's shell-function shim, not a binary on PATH, so a bare subshell cannot see it. (active, 2026-08-29) → `docs/lessons/rg-shim-invisible-to-bare-subshell.md`

- `kb:lesson/squash-merge-never-empties-log-range` — git log main..plan/<plan> showed 27 commits ahead on an already-landed branch, because a squash creates a new commit; 'something to land' is a tree test. (active, 2026-08-31) → `docs/lessons/squash-merge-never-empties-log-range.md`

- `kb:lesson/subagent-never-woken-by-harness` — An agent slept and polled for a backgrounded gate; the harness re-invokes only the main session when a task finishes, so the wait never ended. 60 minutes lost. (active, 2026-09-10; features: canary) → `docs/lessons/subagent-never-woken-by-harness.md`
- `kb:lesson/tiles-never-refit-behind-pattern-match` — No tile ever sent a resize frame while footers pattern-matched geometry and passed; five Criticals lived in the second view the plan's source states omitted. - `kb:lesson/transient-display-is-not-an-oracle` — E12 flaked for weeks on a ~25 ms overlay a later render pass destroys; assert the settled state and prove a flake fix with e2e-soak, not one green run. (active, 2026-09-11; features: surfaces) → `docs/lessons/transient-display-is-not-an-oracle.md`
- `kb:lesson/tree-not-clean-at-pipeline-start` — A plan branch 20 commits behind main, a dirty tracked README in Affected Files, an untracked screenshot: three pre-flight states that nearly corrupted runs. (active, 2026-09-04) → `docs/lessons/tree-not-clean-at-pipeline-start.md`
- `kb:lesson/two-wire-shapes-accepted-hides-disagreement` — An invented {id, display_name} hook field survived two stages because the daemon accepted both shapes: every test green, contract wrong, Opus probe needed. - `kb:lesson/unmentioned-req-costs-a-review-minor` — An implementation log said nothing about one requirement it had deferred; the reviewer reconstructed the intent from the diff. About 25 minutes and a wave. (active, 2026-09-11) → `docs/lessons/unmentioned-req-costs-a-review-minor.md`

- `kb:lesson/validate-repair-weakened-the-assertion` — A narrowed locator pointed where the element is never created, green and asserting nothing; two out-of-delta tests were silently deleted. Majors both. (active, 2026-09-03) → `docs/lessons/validate-repair-weakened-the-assertion.md`
- `kb:lesson/wait-bound-below-sanctioned-blocking` — A 10 s wait over 7 s of sanctioned blocking failed at 10.02 s and read as a shutdown bug; a bound clears the worst case with the arithmetic written down. (active, 2026-09-07) → `docs/lessons/wait-bound-below-sanctioned-blocking.md`
